search_lead.cognate: Armenian մաւրուս (accusative plural of mawru-kʻ, beard) and Vedic śmaśru in the beard epithets continue the beard noun represented by pie-lex-smokjwr. No cognacy of հուր or բոց with hari-/śocis- is asserted.
search_lead.argument: Vahagn emerges from flame with fiery hair and a flame beard; Indra is tawny-bearded and tawny-haired in RV 10.96.8a, while Agni has a golden beard in RV 5.7.7c and flame-hair in RV 3.14.1d. The doubled luminous hair/beard characterization, with the cognate beard noun retained and brightness vocabulary renewed, merits review as inherited divine physiognomy. Evidence is distributed over the Vedic passages rather than an exact single-line equivalent. The Armenian quotation is transmitted in later historiography, and Iranian mediation or broader shared imagery remains possible. These partners are not slab anchors.
